claims.statement: Readiness Engine v1 remains MCQ-only; no free-form expression input exists.
Practice and assessment evidence use separate localStorage keys.
MORE_EVIDENCE_NEEDED remains tied to insufficient answered coverage, not low score.
Golden Template v1.0.1 adds non-breaking mobile/math hardening without changing frozen invariants.

proposed_changes.change: Apply details MathJax re-typeset, 44px touch targets, 8px micro-option gap, bottom CTAs and JSON control-character CI checks.
proposed_changes.rationale: Safe production hardening before CĐ04–CĐ06 rollout.

tests.expected: Current CĐ07 micro/assessment JSON has no hidden control characters or suspicious single TeX backslashes.
Touch targets are explicitly >=44px and micro gap >=8px.
Deploy CI runs both Golden Template and micro-practice validators.

uncertainties: Real-device behavior was already reported good before hardening; post-patch deploy smoke check remains appropriate.

acceptance.notes: Accepted all non-breaking hardening items; rejected score-band redefinition of MORE_EVIDENCE_NEEDED.
